_comment: Issue templates expanded per project by the importer. Each project receives one issue per template (so every project covers all five statuses). dueOffsetDays is relative to 2026-01-01; negative = past. attachment references a file under assets/attachments. comments[].internal marks internal notes; comments[].by is a member slot index (0=assignee/creator, rotates).

templates.title: Inspect and recoat hull below waterline
templates.description: Grit-blast and apply anti-fouling per the coating spec. Confirm anode condition during the same docking.

comments.text: Logged from the pre-docking walk-through. Confirm scope before we release to the yard.
Awaiting paint lead time from Nordic Coatings before scheduling.

templates.title: Replace bridge navigation radar
templates.description: Swap the bridge radar unit and verify integration with the ECDIS and AIS.

comments.text: Crew assigned and old unit removed. New unit on site.
Holding at ~60% — waiting on the integration cable from RadarTech.
Subcontractor confirmed for the commissioning step.

templates.title: Annual safety equipment audit
templates.description: Audit liferafts, EPIRBs, fire systems, and lifejackets; compile the class submission.

comments.text: Audit walkthrough complete; findings compiled for review.
Please review the checklist before I submit to class.

templates.title: Overhaul main engine top end
templates.description: Top-end overhaul at the scheduled running-hour interval. Replace injectors and gaskets.

comments.text: Overhaul completed and area cleaned up.
Sea trial passed; signed off by the chief engineer.

templates.title: Replace sacrificial anodes
templates.description: Replace consumed sacrificial anodes across the hull and running gear.

comments.text: All anodes replaced; old ones logged.

templates.title: Update ECDIS charts and licences
templates.description: Apply the latest ENC update and renew chart licences.

templates.title: Repair HVAC compressor
templates.description: Diagnose and repair the failing AC compressor serving the guest cabins.

comments.text: Compressor isolated; ordering a replacement seal kit.

templates.description: Routine service of the tender crane hydraulic system.
